subject: Food Science
title: Sugar Refining
description: Learn Sugar Refining in one minute.

hook.text: Sugarcane goes through 8 processing steps to become white crystals. Raw sugarcane juice is 14% sugar.

buildup.text: Processing: crush, extract juice, clarify with lime, evaporate water, crystallize, centrifuge, wash, and dry.

discovery.text: Brown sugar isn't 'less processed'—it's usually white sugar with molasses added back.

twist.text: Adding calcium hydroxide (lime) during clarification removes 35% of the minerals naturally present.

climax.text: Beet sugar and cane sugar are chemically identical—pure sucrose. You can't distinguish them in a blind taste test despite.

punchline.text: Eight steps turn cane into crystals. Brown sugar is white sugar in disguise.

quiz.question: Is brown sugar less processed than white sugar?
options: Yes, it skips several refining steps
Usually no—it's often white sugar with molasses added back
